'''Matcha Flavoured 0.4-alpha''', the "Sulfur Update!", is a release of [[Matcha Flavoured]], published on June 17, 2026. It was the first version for ''Minecraft'' 26.2. It adapted the pack to the new vanilla sulfur blocks and added several armor sets and weapons.<ref>{{Cite changelog|0.4-alpha}}</ref>

== Additions ==
=== Equipment ===
* [[Sturdy leather armor]].
* [[Chainmail armor]].
* Electrum and steel [[spear]]s.
* The [[Silver Sword|silver sword]], [[Warding Sword|warding sword]] and [[Warding Shield|warding shield]].
* The [[Wooden Cross|wooden cross]].
* Pack equipment added to every [[Chest loot|chest loot table]], and the loot tables buffed.

=== Blocks and items ===
* Support for the new vanilla sulfur blocks alongside the existing sulfur chunks.
* [[Sulfur Goo|Sulfur goo]], a retextured slimeball.
* [[Sulfurous Hellstone|Sulfurous hellstone]] gives off particles when stepped on.

=== General ===
* Translation support for all armor and tools.
* A [[Piglin|piglin]] bartering loot table, which only works while <code>mobGriefing</code> is off.
* Gems can be sold to the [[Jeweler|jeweler]].
* Wake particles behind boats.
* New textures: leather and adamant armor items, baby zombie and zombie villager, and the adamant spear.

== Changes ==
* [[Prayer of Prometheus|Prometheus' Prayer]] buffed to Unbreaking II.
* The bronze (now [[Hepatizon equipment|hepatizon]]) spear buffed to Lunge III.
* Leather, gold and steel armor now have white name text.
* Armor durability and protection made consistent across tiers: leather < copper < gold, sturdy leather < iron, shakudo, bronze (hepatizon), steel < diamond, electrum < adamant.
* [[Piglin|Piglin brutes]] drop [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]] slightly less often, and now also drop [[Divine Fragment|divine fragments]].
* [[Skeleton]]s and [[zombie]]s no longer drop the armor and weapons they hold.
* [[Cave Spider|Cave spiders]] are fast but have only 2 hearts.
* [[Creeper]]s have 8 hearts.
* Sulfur cubes are "more cute".
* Sulfur is now the [[Sulfur Chunk|sulfur chunk]], with a slightly changed texture.
* Sulfur ores, including sulfurous hellstone, restyled to match the vanilla sulfur blocks.

== Fixes ==
* [[Shakudo equipment|Shakudo]] armor could not be crafted.
* Fixed the shakudo sword, and its life-steal enchantment ("Sanguine") no longer works on armor stands.
* Leather and [[Tattered Leather|tattered leather]] unlock the right recipes.
* [[Warding]] on [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] tools and weapons did not work.
* [[Sulfurous Quartz Deposit|Sulfurous quartz]] drops both sulfur and quartz.

== Removals ==
* Electrum horse armor, for the time being.
* The "You cannot eat right now" warning.

== Trivia ==
* The release notes point out that electrum armor still wards the dead when worn or held by non-players, and that the developer decided to keep this bug because "it seems like a feature".
